headword: {上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}
reading: じょうわんにとうきん

definitions.explanation: The large muscle on the front of the upper arm that flexes the elbow; the biceps. An anatomical term that is also common in fitness contexts.

examples.japanese: {上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げる→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: When you bend your arm, the biceps bulges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げる→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧⟦{動作|どうさ}→動作：04074_dousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{上腕二頭筋|じょうわんにとうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: In the motion of lifting heavy objects, the biceps works hard.

notes:
⟦{上腕|じょうわん}→上腕：29742_jouwan⟧ (upper arm) + {二頭|にとう} (two-headed) + {筋|きん} (muscle). The muscle you flex to make a "muscle bump."
